ayahOccurrences.text: تَلْفَحُ وُجُوهَهُمُ ٱلنَّارُ وَهُمْ فِيهَا كَٰلِحُونَ
ayahOccurrences.highlightedHtml: تَلْفَحُ وُجُوهَهُمُ ٱلنَّارُ وَهُمْ فِيهَا كَٰلِحُونَ

lexSnapshot.derivativeNote: كَٰلِحُونَ is in the derivative form: كَالِحُون
lexSnapshot.rootDefinitionHtml:
ك/ل/ح   k–l–ḥ scowling, frowning, to be grave, austere; hardship, famine; succession of thunderbolts. Of this root, كَالِحُون kāliḥūn occurs 1 time in the Qur’an
.
lexSnapshot.mainDefinitionHtml:
كَالِحُون kāliḥūn [pl. of act. part. كَالِح kāliḥ] scowling, glowering, gloomy

(23:104) تَلْفَحُ وُجُوهَهُمُ النَّارُ وَهُمْ فِيهَا كَالِحُونَ the Fire will scorch their faces and they will abide in it scowling [in pain].
